role: post-hoc development and evaluation; no new independent validation
fit_sessions: all three separated-power development sessions only; equal session weights
evaluation_sessions: all six already-seen separated-power confirmation sessions; retained without exclusions
sample_availability: original progress event mono_ns; interpolation endpoints must already be recorded
window_end: midpoint of latest available power sample; exact trailing 10 seconds
r_definition: mean observed whole-device W minus actual past state increment W minus pre[-20,30] background W
future_r: hold last available r for the complete 10/30 second forecast; no future refresh inside that issued forecast
future_schedule: stored original planned schedule; no future realized completion inputs and no new adaptive scheduler claim
missing_rule: null with reason; no zero fill, endpoint extrapolation, or invalid-sample removal
coefficient_sensitivity: per-session information/cross-products; leave-one-development-session-out gamma; no IID sample confidence interval
selection: no accuracy PASS threshold invented; retain zero-boundary or sign-unstable result without a second candidate search
